subject.title: [Feature]: Talk/Voice tab — agent/session switching + per-agent TTS voice

question: Should the remaining Talk/Voice selector work land Android-first using existing gateway agent/session state, or wait for a shared Android/iOS/macOS Talk UX decision?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but choosing platform scope and persistent selected-agent semantics is user-facing product direction across companion-app session state.

options.title: Android-first Talk selector
options.body: Implement the Android Voice/Talk selector first, reuse existing gateway agent/session state, and validate real multi-agent Talk routing before expanding to other apps.

options.title: Shared companion-app design
options.body: Pause implementation until maintainers choose one Talk/Voice selector model for Android, iOS, and macOS.

options.title: Wait for Chat selector outcome
options.body: Let the Android Chat selector PR resolve its session-state model first, then reuse the accepted model for Talk/Voice.

recommendation.title: Android-first Talk selector
recommendation.body: Implement the Android Voice/Talk selector first, reuse existing gateway agent/session state, and validate real multi-agent Talk routing before expanding to other apps.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete already scoped the TTS half as implemented and the Talk/Voice selector as remaining in the issue discussion.
